The Raichur Doab (Antarvedi) is the fertile tract of land situated between the Krishna and Tungabhadra rivers. Because of its fertile black cotton soil and strategic location, the Raichur Doab became one of the most disputed regions in medieval South India. It witnessed repeated conflicts among the Chalukyas, Cholas, Bahmanis, Vijayanagara rulers and the Deccan Sultanates. The famous Battle of Raichur (1520 CE) between Sri Krishnadevaraya and the Adil Shah of Bijapur was fought for the control of this region.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (1).

x:
The Telugu Ganga Project is an inter-state water project designed primarily to supply drinking water to Chennai (Tamil Nadu) while also providing irrigation benefits to Andhra Pradesh. The project utilizes surplus waters of the Krishna River and conveys them through a network of reservoirs and canals. Water flows through Srisailam Reservoir, Somasila Reservoir, Kandaleru Reservoir, and finally reaches Poondi Reservoir near Chennai. Apart from supplying drinking water to Chennai, the project also provides irrigation facilities to drought-prone districts of Rayalaseema and parts of Nellore district. The project is an example of interstate cooperation involving Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Maharashtra and Tamil Nadu. However, the state receiving drinking water under the project is Tamil Nadu.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (4).
n: Purpose – Drinking water supply to Chennai

Which of the following statements is/are incorrect?
a. Billa Surgam Palaeolithic cave site is located in Anantapuramu district.
b. Belum caves located in Nandyal district is the second longest cave in India.
c. Cave sites of Kurnool and Muchatla Chintamani Gavi in A.P. are the only places in India where tools made of animal bones were found in upper palaeolithic context
x:
Let us examine each statement separately. Statement (a): "Billa Surgam Palaeolithic cave site is located in Anantapuramu district." This statement is incorrect. The famous Billa Surgam Caves are located in Kurnool district (present administrative region falls under Nandyal district after district reorganisation), not in Anantapuramu. These caves are internationally significant because they have yielded evidence of prehistoric human occupation. Statement (b): "Belum Caves located in Nandyal district is the second longest cave in India." This statement is correct. Belum Caves are located in Nandyal district and are the second longest natural cave system in India, after Krem Liat Prah in Meghalaya. Statement (c): "Cave sites of Kurnool and Muchatla Chintamani Gavi are the only places in India where tools made of animal bones were found in Upper Palaeolithic context." This statement is correct. Archaeological excavations have revealed bone tools from these cave sites, making them unique in the Indian prehistoric context.
Therefore, only statement (a) is incorrect.
n: Belum Caves – Second longest natural cave system in India
Bone tools – Kurnool cave sites are unique in India
